encounters.name: The Diving Bell
encounters.desc: Two divers in brass helmets and the eels that live in their suits. The divers shrug off blows; lightning gets in.
encounters.intro: They went down to look for the king. They came back. Without. Their faces.

encounters.name: The Widow's Walk
encounters.desc: The widow nets whoever crosses the bridge; the footmen hold the far end. Rooted heroes take double from her knife.
encounters.intro: She is waiting for someone. On the bridge. It is not you. She will take you. Anyway.

encounters.name: The Eel Pool
encounters.desc: Fast eels and a net-thrower among the islands. Every round two more tiles flood.
encounters.intro: Do not put your hand in. Do not put. Your hand. In.

encounters.name: Salvage Rights
encounters.desc: A full salvage crew: two divers up front, a tide-priest to mend them, a widow with a net.
encounters.intro: Everything down here belongs to someone. They are. Collecting.

encounters.name: The Lamp Keeper
encounters.desc: The lighthouse walked inland. Its beam sweeps a line a turn after it is marked: get out of the light.
encounters.intro: It is still turning. Still warning. Ships. There are no ships. There is you.

encounters.name: The Deep Crew
encounters.desc: Two veteran divers in the mud and a widow to pin you in place for them.
encounters.intro: The ones who went deepest. They did not. Come up. All the way.

encounters.name: The Ferryman
encounters.desc: He takes a card as his fare and sweeps you off the landing. At half strength the flood rises and his passengers climb out.
encounters.intro: He rows people across. Water. That used to be streets. You have not paid.

encounters.name: Moths in the Choir Loft
encounters.desc: Moths that ate the hymnals. Their dust dazes. The wretches are just hungry.
encounters.intro: They ate. The hymn books. Every word. Now they sing. With their wings.

encounters.name: The Gravediggers
encounters.desc: The sexton shields its penitents and shoves you toward the pits. Where penitents fall, the floor comes alive.
encounters.intro: Somebody has to dig. Somebody. Has to fill them.

encounters.name: Thurible
encounters.desc: The censer-bearer makes everything near it regenerate. Kill it first or fight forever.
encounters.intro: Breathe in. It smells like. A hospital. Breathe in.

encounters.name: The Queue for Confession
encounters.desc: A long line of penitents waiting their turn, kept fresh by incense. They would like you to wait too.
encounters.intro: Take a number. They have. All taken numbers. Nobody has been called.

encounters.name: The Wedding
encounters.desc: The bride regenerates and marks whoever she touches. Halfway down, her bridesmaids arrive and she speeds up.
encounters.intro: Everyone rise. She has been. Walking. Up this aisle. For a very long time.

encounters.name: The Night Vigil
encounters.desc: A veteran sexton holds the line; the censer keeps everyone regenerating behind it.
encounters.intro: They keep the vigil. All night. Every night. Tonight. For you.

encounters.name: The Confessor
encounters.desc: Absolution hurts from anywhere. Whispered Sins winds up a turn before it frightens everything within 2. Penance makes your heroes take more damage.
encounters.intro: Behind the grille. It listens. It remembers. Everything. Kneel.

encounters.name: The Stokehold
encounters.desc: Stokers with hot shovels and mites that run at you and go off. The stokers do not burn.
encounters.intro: Feed the fire. Feed the fire. There is no. Engine. Feed the fire.

encounters.name: Clocking On
encounters.desc: While the punch clock stands, every machine on shift is hasted. Break the clock.
encounters.intro: Clack. Clack. Everyone is. On time. Except you.

encounters.name: Spider Track
encounters.desc: Rail spiders reel stragglers in on cables. You are surrounded and they move first. Stay together.
encounters.intro: They lay the track. Anything on the track. Gets laid. Under.

encounters.name: The Night Shift
encounters.desc: A full shift, punched in and hasted. The clock is behind them. Get to it.
encounters.intro: Nights are. Longer. Here. Nobody. Clocks out.

encounters.name: The Strikebreaker
encounters.desc: It cannot be pushed and it shoves everything around it away. At half strength it calls a hound and hits harder.
encounters.intro: There was a strike. Once. There is not. Any more. He saw to it.

encounters.name: The Spider Shed
encounters.desc: Two veteran rail spiders and a tinker wiring the floor. Do not get separated.
encounters.intro: This is where they. Keep. The ones that broke. Down.

encounters.name: The Prospector
encounters.desc: Dynamite is marked a turn before it goes off: move. In his second half the shaft caves in around him and gold fever takes his side.
encounters.intro: Found gold. Once. Has been digging. Ever since. You are standing. On his claim.

encounters.name: Spillage
encounters.desc: Somebody spilled a drink across the map in round three. It slows whatever it touches and leaves the floor wet.
encounters.intro: Steve. Knocked it over. Steve. Never. Cleaned it up.

encounters.name: Keeping Score
encounters.desc: The scorekeeper marks you and crosses you out; the paper knights do the rest.
encounters.intro: Somebody. Has to. Keep score. I have. Kept. Every score.

encounters.name: Under the Tablecloth
encounters.desc: Two cloths lie flat and wait for someone to stand alone. Keep together.
encounters.intro: Lift the cloth. There is nothing. Under. Lift the cloth. Again.

encounters.name: The Final Tally
encounters.desc: A veteran scorekeeper weakening your hitters while the cloth smothers stragglers and the die rolls itself at you.
encounters.intro: Add it up. Add. It. Up. You are. Short.
